IS 269.title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43 and 53 Grade)
IS 269.consolidation_summary: In the 2015 revision, IS 269, IS 8112 (43 Grade), and IS 12269 (53 Grade) were unified into a single comprehensive standard IS 269:2015 covering 33, 43, and 53 grades of OPC.

latest_amendments.summary: Permissible performance improvers and mineral admixture inclusion thresholds revised.
Updated packaging norms, net mass tolerance, and eco-labeling requirements.

IS 383.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification

historical_versions.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregates from Natural Sources for Concrete (Second Revision)

IS 383.consolidation_summary: IS 383:2016 (Third Revision) expanded scope significantly beyond natural sources to include Manufactured Sand (M-Sand), Recycled Concrete Aggregate (RCA), Recycled Aggregate (RA), and Iron/Steel Slag Aggregates.

latest_amendments.summary: Fine aggregate grading limits and micro-fines percentage passing for Crushed Stone Sand (M-Sand) updated.

IS 456.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice

historical_versions.title: Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete (Third Revision)

IS 456.consolidation_summary: IS 456:2000 introduces durability-based mix design guidelines, exposure condition categorization (Mild, Moderate, Severe, Very Severe, Extreme), and minimum cement content provisions.

latest_amendments.summary: Clarifications on design bond stress and anchorage length for deformed bars.
Allowing use of Recycled Concrete Aggregate (RCA) up to 20% in reinforced concrete and 100% in plain concrete.

IS 1489 (Part 1).title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification (Part 1: Fly Ash Based)

historical_versions.title: Portland Pozzolana Cement Part 1 Fly Ash Based (Third Revision)

IS 1489 (Part 1).consolidation_summary: Fly ash replacement ratio defined between 15% and 35% with enhanced fineness requirements and updated test reference standards.

latest_amendments.summary: Standardization of packaging sizes and environmental product declaration criteria.

IS 1489 (Part 2).title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification (Part 2: Calcined Clay Based)

historical_versions.title: Portland Pozzolana Cement Part 2 Calcined Clay Based (Third Revision)

IS 1489 (Part 2).consolidation_summary: Covers calcined clay pozzolana admixture requirements, offering high resistance to sulphate attack.

IS 455.title: Portland Slag Cement — Specification
IS 455.consolidation_summary: Covers blast furnace slag based Portland cement with slag ratio between 25% and 70%, ideal for marine and wastewater applications.

IS 1786.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification

historical_versions.title: Specification for High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires (Third Revision)

IS 1786.consolidation_summary: Introduced Fe 500D, Fe 550D, Fe 600 grades with enhanced elongation and ductile characteristics for seismic zones.

latest_amendments.summary: Mandatory micro-alloying and carbon equivalent ceilings for superior weldability.

IS 1343.title: Prestressed Concrete — Code of Practice

historical_versions.title: Code of Practice for Prestressed Concrete (First Revision)

IS 1343.consolidation_summary: Updated limit state design method for prestressed concrete elements, loss of prestress formulas, and shear design.

IS 4926.title: Ready-Mixed Concrete — Code of Practice
IS 4926.consolidation_summary: Covers ordering, production, transportation, quality control, sampling and testing for Ready-Mixed Concrete (RMC).

IS 2116.title: Sand for Masonry Mortars — Specification
IS 2116.consolidation_summary: Covers grading and deleterious materials limits for natural and crushed stone sand used in masonry mortars.

IS 3466.title: Masonry Cement — Specification
IS 3466.consolidation_summary: Specification for masonry cement intended for non-structural masonry mortars and plastering works.

IS 6452.title: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use — Specification
IS 6452.consolidation_summary: High early-strength refractory and cold-weather cement specification.

IS 6909.title: Supersulphated Cement — Specification
IS 6909.consolidation_summary: Specialized cement for marine structures, sulphate-bearing soils, and acidic industrial effluent channels.

IS 1077.title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks — Specification
IS 1077.consolidation_summary: Specifies physical dimensions, compressive strength classes (3.5 to 35 MPa), and water absorption for burnt clay bricks.

IS 12894.title: Pulverized Fuel Ash-Lime Bricks — Specification
IS 12894.consolidation_summary: Specifies quality, compressive strength, and durability for eco-friendly fly ash-lime building bricks.
